status.clear: No compliance checks are pending for this account.
status.checking: A routine compliance check is in progress.
status.nameNeeded: We need your full legal name to complete a compliance check. Please add it to your account.
status.review: A compliance check needs a person's review. This usually takes about one business day.
status.suspended: This account is suspended for legal reasons.
status.appealPending: This account is suspended for legal reasons. Your appeal is with a reviewer who did not take the original decision.

screening.paymentsPaused: Until it is complete, payments, payouts, sales and commercial commitments are paused. Nothing in your account is deleted.
screening.contact: If you have questions, contact the operator of this site through the contact details in its terms of service.

appeal.available: You can appeal this decision. A reviewer who did not take the original decision will answer.
appeal.title: Appeal the decision
appeal.reasonLabel: Why do you think the decision is wrong?
appeal.submitted: Your appeal was sent. We will tell you the outcome.

refusal.suspended: This account is suspended for legal reasons. You can read your compliance status and appeal.

gate.companyPaused: Payments and commercial commitments of your company are paused until a compliance check is complete. An administrator of the company can see its compliance status.

console.nodeScope: These records and decisions cover the whole node, including every hub.
console.unavailable: Unknown metrics need recorded hub cohorts.
console.saved: Saved. The current record has been refreshed.
console.refused: The action was refused. Refresh and check your access. Request:
console.unknownOutcome: The outcome is unknown. Retry the same submission to retrieve its result; do not submit a changed decision.
console.notifications: A compliance review needs attention. No names are included in notifications.
console.title: Screening
console.lede: Sanctions compliance: lists, matches decided by people, jurisdiction holds and re-screening.
console.rule: No control loosens matching, pauses a baseline list or clears a hold without a reason.
console.stale: Screening unavailable: payments and commitments are paused until the baseline lists are fresh again.
console.secondRequired: You cannot approve your own request.
console.proposalNote: Your decision binds the digest shown above; if the action changes, the request becomes void.
console.audit: This action is recorded in the audit log.
console.readOnly: Read only: your roles do not include changing this.
console.participantScope: This page shows only the authorized compliance panel. Other participant information is not connected.
console.listReadOnly: Lists and versions are read-only. No baseline or matching controls.
console.cohortRule: Metrics require at least 10 distinct principals. Unknown is not zero.
console.noEligibleDurations: No completed run with a proven cohort is available.
console.moneyClear: No stored screening hold; each transaction checks current gates

listControls.title: Additional list configuration
listControls.boundary: The baseline stays on. File imports use registered country-pack facts and implemented adapters. Another compliance officer approves the exact configuration. Live downloads require separate provider authority and are unavailable here.
listControls.noSources: No eligible export source is registered. Query adapters and unreviewed facts cannot be used as list imports.
